opportunities.title: 432Hz frequency-tuned listening demand
opportunities.need: Listeners want music retuned to 432Hz/528Hz/Solfeggio frequencies for a perceived calming or connective effect, despite scientific skepticism

audience.description: English-speaking wellness-curious listeners and musicians interested in alternative tuning frequencies

opportunities.consumption_context: active listening via retuned streaming audio or live music performances

evidence.statement: Grammy-winning artist Ziggy Marley publicly describes retuning his live band to 432Hz, saying it has an impact and effect on the audience and band connection.
Coverage frames 432Hz as a growing social media trend while scientists push back that effects are more about perception than any special frequency.
Browser extension exists to retune Spotify, YouTube and Apple Music audio in real time to 432Hz/528Hz/Solfeggio frequencies, with a 4/5 average rating, indicating consumer-side tooling demand.

hypotheses.potential_positioning: Native 432Hz-tuned instrumental tracks so listeners don't need third-party retuning tools
hypotheses.first_content_direction: Release tracks explicitly tuned/labeled at 432Hz with framing around connection and calm
hypotheses.format: full tracks + short clips explaining the tuning choice
hypotheses.hook: What if your favorite calming music was tuned to 432Hz?
